title: Wolf Pelts
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Lee of York

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 12 Wolf Pelts in Dew Valley Forest.

Quest Reward: 125 gold.

Return to: Sir Lee of York

Repeatable: Yes, as More Wolf Pelts

Following Quest: Deliver Wolf Pelts

NOTE: Before build 130 this quest was given by Samford the Hermit.

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 12 Wolf Pelts in Dew Valley Forest. Afterward, return to Sir Lee of York in Dew Valley.

Offer:

Back again for another quest? Sheesh, speaking in Ye Olde Lingo is hard. Give me a moment to get my game face on, will you?

Ah, courageous hero, 'tis a most, er, dreary day for those that travel through the Forest of Dew Valley. The wolves doth attack, um, and no one defends the weaklings. I mean, the weak. Wouldst thou, uh, slay those wolves so dangerous? If thou doest this task, returneth to me and I shall happily purchase the pelts from you with, um, coin of the realm.''

Turn-in:

A most dreary day. Pretty good line, eh? I think I'm getting better with this nonsense-talk, don't you?

Now, hand over those pelts. I'm thinking of making a coat out of these to wear next time I walk through Dew Valley Forest.

Objectives:

  • Wolf Pelt ×12

Level range: 1–10
